points.description: States that the algorithm must be implemented (written as an actual program/code in a programming language and run).
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if only 'run/test the algorithm' is stated without saying it is implemented as a program

points.description: States that the physical (actual, real clock) running time is measured, e.g. using a timer/system clock, as opposed to counting operations or analysing theoretically.
points.partial_credit: 1.5 marks if 'measure the running time' is stated but without specifying physical/actual/clock time

rubric.notes: Full marks need both: the algorithm is implemented as a program AND its physical (actual clock) running time is measured. Vague answers such as 'test it' or 'see how fast it is' earn nothing or at most part marks as stated. Answers describing theoretical analysis, counting primitive operations or pseudocode/big-O earn no marks for the measurement point; any wrong statement about a point voids that point.
